items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Now we come from Uptown to come see Dipper, get off at Petita and Rampart. I noticed he was kind of funny... I said, oh, no, come outside. We talk about the wine.

ctx.x: Well, that's the place I promoted the interest to. He was in love with Larry Mack. And Joe asked to play from eight. Well in mind, it'd be alright if he could go make that little job from eight to eleven and put, he's called Lewis, he used to call him Dipper, put Dipper in his place. So, I said, you know, it's alright with me. Alright, you go play. So, here comes the Monday night. Opposition, Cooperative Hall and Comedy Hall. I had a little Joe at the theater. St. Louis. Yeah, we playing up there for God's soul.…
